text:
Developing a mobile app is an exciting but demanding process. A crucial first decision is choosing between native and cross-platform development. Native apps, built specifically for iOS or Android, often deliver superior performance and smoother animations, but require separate codebases. Cross-platform tools like Flutter or React Native allow one codebase for both, saving time and money, though they may have minor performance trade-offs.

Regardless of the approach, responsive design is non-negotiable. Your app must look and function seamlessly across various screen sizes and orientations. Finally, remember that app stores are your gateway to users. To get approved, you must follow strict guidelines, and after launch, you must monitor user feedback and performance metrics to release regular updates and fix bugs effectively.
